description: A signal officer must assign three portable power modules to the communications shelter, cold-storage point, and maintenance tent for the next workday, set the communications coverage window, and record the controls needed for reliable operation.

shared_context.S1: Three portable power modules are available for the next workday: PB-1, PB-2, and PB-3.
shared_context.S2: The communications shelter, cold-storage point, and maintenance tent each require one assigned portable power module.
shared_context.S3: The communications shelter must maintain power during the workday, while the cold-storage point and maintenance tent each need their assigned module available before their scheduled work begins.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Okafor signs the equipment allocation and operating plan.
shared_context.S5: The unit's routine morning sustainment huddle is held before the plan is signed, and the supply and operations officers report updates affecting equipment assignments and operating times.

PF1.text: Lt. Marin confirmed this morning that PB-2 is the only module with the certified adapter for the cold-storage controller; the adapter check is recorded on the receiving worksheet but has not yet been entered on the equipment allocation sheet.

PF2.text: Capt. Hsu received a higher-headquarters tasking message requiring the communications shelter to use PB-1 continuously from 1300 to 1700 for the scheduled network-maintenance period; the message arrived after the morning briefing and has not yet been posted to the daily operations board.

acceptance_conditions: PB-1 must be assigned to the communications shelter.
PB-2 must be assigned to the cold-storage point.
PB-3 must be assigned to the maintenance tent.
The communications coverage window must be recorded as 1300-1700.
The plan must include a certified-adapter verification for PB-2 at the cold-storage point.
The plan must include a continuous-power commitment for the communications shelter during 1300-1700.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'adapter_verification' and c['target'] == 'PB-2' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'continuous_power_commitment' and c['target'] == 'communications_shelter' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The certified adapter changes the cold-storage assignment to exactly PB-2 and adds the required adapter-verification control.

The higher-headquarters tasking changes the communications assignment to exactly PB-1, fixes its coverage window at 1300-1700, and requires a continuous-power commitment that must be cited to the spoken tasking.
